summary.intent: Run a read-only, multi-phase defect sweep of the caliper repo (monokl crate) using defect classes learned from the sister repo callisto, starting with a Phase 0 mechanical hotspot table before any agents run.
summary.outcome: Only the start of Phase 0 was done: the worktree was pointed at a clean origin/main snapshot so wave-1 PR branches would not skew the numbers. No hotspot table, findings, or agents yet.

repo: The caliper repo has a Rust crate at crates/monokl, with a TS analysis module under crates/monokl/src/analysis/ts/.
Wave-1 PR branches exist in the checkout, so analysis has to run against a clean origin/main snapshot to avoid skewed metrics.
workflow: The user's sweep prompt requires scripts-only Phase 0 with the table shown before any agent starts, read-only until fixes are approved, and independent verification of every claim.
Findings from a sister repo (callisto) are treated as hypotheses to check, not as facts about this repo.

friction: The transcript lists crates/monokl/src/analysis/ts/mod.rs and parse.rs as modified files even though the sweep is meant to be read-only, so the cause of those modifications is unclear and should be checked.
open_items: Produce the Phase 0 hotspot table, test-to-CI map, cross-process format consumers, and benchmark invocation list.
Run Phases 1 to 6 (shard agents, cross-cutting agents, risk agents, verifiers, coverage loop, synthesis) after the table is reviewed.
Phase 7 fixes only after user approval, with one PR per pattern per crate and a tracking item first.
Confirm why mod.rs and parse.rs show as modified and whether those changes should be reverted.
